sources.title: Bookworm Wiki: Dungeon Crawler Carl, Book 1 timeline
A Book Lover's Digest: Dungeon Crawler Carl, Book 1

events.summary: The First Floor opens and its five-day collapse countdown is displayed.
Carl and Donut enter the First Floor as the 4,119th and 4,122nd crawlers.
After Donut becomes a crawler, she forms the two-member Royal Court of Princess Donut with Carl.

party.name: The Royal Court of Princess Donut

events.summary: Carl unlocks Crazy Cat Lady.

achievement.title: Crazy Cat Lady
achievement.description: Entered the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat.

events.summary: Donut unlocks Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady.

achievement.title: Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady
achievement.description: The first crawler to enter the World Dungeon with a cat.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Early Adopter.

achievement.title: Early Adopter
achievement.description: One of the first 5,000 crawlers to enter a new World Dungeon.

events.summary: The Dungeon System awards Carl a Silver Adventurer Box for Early Adopter.

item.name: Silver Adventurer Box
item.description: Awarded for the Early Adopter achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Empty Pockets.

achievement.title: Empty Pockets
achievement.description: Entered the dungeon without supplies.

events.summary: The Dungeon System awards Carl a Bronze Adventurer Box for Empty Pockets.

item.name: Bronze Adventurer Box
item.description: Awarded for the Empty Pockets achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?.

achievement.title: Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?
achievement.description: Entered the dungeon without pants.

events.summary: The Dungeon System awards Carl a Gold Apparel Box for Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?.

item.name: Gold Apparel Box
item.description: Awarded for the Why Aren't You Wearing Pants? achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Unarmed Combat.

achievement.title: Unarmed Combat
achievement.description: Entered the World Dungeon without a weapon.

events.summary: The Dungeon System awards Carl a Bronze Weapon Box for Unarmed Combat.

item.name: Bronze Weapon Box
item.description: Awarded for the Unarmed Combat achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

events.summary: Carl opens the Silver Adventurer Box awarded for Early Adopter.
Carl opens the Bronze Adventurer Box awarded for Empty Pockets.
Carl opens the Gold Apparel Box awarded for Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?.
Carl opens the Bronze Weapon Box awarded for Unarmed Combat.
Carl unlocks Loner.

achievement.title: Loner
achievement.description: Entered without any human companions.

events.summary: Carl and Donut begin the First Floor tutorial.
Cascadia closes the surface stairwells; just under 13 million entered and fewer than 10 million remain.
Carl and Donut complete the First Floor tutorial.
Carl unlocks Fall into an Obvious Trap.

achievement.title: Fall into an Obvious Trap
achievement.description: No achievement notification text is preserved by the source.

reward.description: A warning that Carl is about to meet his maker.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign.

achievement.title: You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign
achievement.description: Read an official dungeon sign.

reward.description: Official signs are highlighted and nearby guilds appear on the minimap.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob.

achievement.title: You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob
achievement.description: Damaged a mob for the first time.

reward.description: The mob will probably hit back.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You've Killed a Mob!.

achievement.title: You've Killed a Mob!
achievement.description: Killed a mob for the first time.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!.

achievement.title: You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!
achievement.description: Killed an armed mob with bare hands.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level Than Yourself!.

achievement.title: You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level Than Yourself!
achievement.description: Killed a mob above Carl’s level.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You've Entered a Guildhall!.

achievement.title: You've Entered a Guildhall!
achievement.description: Entered a guildhall.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Podophilia!.

achievement.title: Podophilia!
achievement.description: Killed an opponent by crushing it with bare feet.

reward.description: Gold Shoe Box containing the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph

events.summary: Carl unlocks Boom!.

achievement.title: Boom!
achievement.description: Caused a wall-shaking explosion in the dungeon.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Level-Up, Baby!.

achievement.title: Level-Up, Baby!
achievement.description: Gained enough experience to reach a new level.

reward.description: No extra reward beyond the level.

events.summary: Carl reaches Level 2.
Carl receives the Goblin Pass Tattoo.
Carl acquires the Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling.

item.name: Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling
item.description: A regenerating enchanted undershirt that resists several disruptive combat effects.

events.summary: Carl receives the basic healing spell in the Magic menu tutorial.
Carl unlocks Loot!.

achievement.title: Loot!
achievement.description: Wore an item found in the dungeon.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Oooh, Magic!.

achievement.title: Oooh, Magic!
achievement.description: Wore magical gear for the first time.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Boss Babe.

achievement.title: Boss Babe
achievement.description: Damaged a dungeon boss.

events.summary: Carl acquires the Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness.

item.name: Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness
item.description: A cloak that adds 4 Constitution and provides poison, ice, and anti-piercing protection.

events.summary: Carl acquires the Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk.

item.name: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk
item.description: A toe ring that adds 3 Strength and improves Powerful Strike.

events.summary: Carl equips the Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk.
Carl reaches Level 3.
Carl acquires a Silver Ring of +1 CON.
Carl reaches Level 5.
The system reports 4,322,395 crawlers remaining on the First Floor.
The system reports 4,148,111 crawlers remaining on the First Floor.
The Royal Court confronts the Hoarder.
Carl acquires the Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces after the Hoarder battle.

item.name: Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces
item.description: Spiked kneepads that reflect 10% of damage and cancel momentum-based attacks.

events.summary: Dungeon Crawler World episode one airs, showing spine-covered wolves, fire blobs, floating stingrays, floating eyeballs, and the first Borough Boss defeat by a 10-person crawler group; 4,006,002 crawlers remain.

A Cascadia patch populates the Floor 2 stairs, announces the descent head-start rule, reports 15 Borough Bosses and more than 1,500 Neighborhood Bosses killed, and changes Fire Fingers, hallway-bathroom explosions, toilet paper, mob inventory, and inventory momentum rules.
Carl reaches Level 7.
Carl reaches Level 8.
Carl acquires the Goblin Copper Chopper.

item.name: Goblin Copper Chopper
item.description: A goblin-built chopper used for traversal and battlefield construction.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You Monster!.

achievement.title: You Monster!
achievement.description: Killed goblin children during the goblin chieftain-room explosion.

events.summary: Carl unlocks War Criminal.

achievement.title: War Criminal
achievement.description: Killed more than twenty noncombatants with one attack.

events.summary: The system reports 3,594,517 crawlers remaining on the First Floor.
Carl receives the Desperado Pass Tattoo.
Carl acquires a Silver Ring of +2 CON.
Carl reaches Level 9.
Carl reaches Level 10.
Dungeon Crawler World episode two airs, including the Royal Court's encounter with Frank Q and Maggie My.

First Floor rules change: toilet suction and bathroom explosions are resolved; language and cross-language support are added; Feral Rabies is curable and no longer airborne; Blender Fiends move down; Street Preacher becomes a Borough Boss; mob strength levels are adjusted.
Donut receives Puddle Jumper from the post-Juicer loot boxes.
Carl acquires the Enchanted War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull.

item.name: Enchanted War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull
item.description: A wrist brace that transforms into a spiked war gauntlet when Carl makes a fist, adding 1 Dexterity and 3 Strength in fist mode.

events.summary: A crawler unlocks Bitchmeat.

achievement.title: Bitchmeat
achievement.description: Was attacked by a fellow crawler in a safe room and required the system’s help.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Two Chicks at the Same Time.

achievement.title: Two Chicks at the Same Time
achievement.description: Killed two mobs at once by using their bodies against one another.

events.summary: The Royal Court meets Meadow Lark.
Dungeon Crawler World episode three airs as the system reports 2,552,085 crawlers remaining.
A late First Floor patch changes spells and mob power levels and reiterates the warning not to use hallways as bathrooms.
Royal Court, Meadow Lark, and Agatha defeat the Ball of Swine using Carl's explosives and the dungeon architecture.
Crawlers can descend to Floor 2 without the usual six-hour loss.
The party unlocks Borough Boss!.

achievement.title: Borough Boss!
achievement.description: Entered a borough-boss chamber.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Bully and a Thief!.

achievement.title: Bully and a Thief!
achievement.description: Inadvertently took Agatha’s shopping cart into inventory during the Ball of Swine fight.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Battlefield Construction!.

achievement.title: Battlefield Construction!
achievement.description: Built and deployed a structure in battle.

events.summary: Carl unlocks This Little Piggy Went to Market!.

achievement.title: This Little Piggy Went to Market!
achievement.description: Killed more than five opponents in boss fights with bare feet.

events.summary: The party unlocks You Found Stairs!.

achievement.title: You Found Stairs!
achievement.description: Found a stairwell down to the next floor.

reward.description: No material reward; surviving to read the notification is the reward.

events.summary: Carl reaches the stairs and completes the First Floor.
The First Floor collapses; 1,292,526 crawlers remain and more than 700,000 die in the collapse.
Dungeon Crawler World episode four airs, highlighting three-headed baboons, eggplants with teeth, crawler fights, and races for the stairs.
Early Floor 2 stairwell portal access opens before the formal floor countdown begins.
Carl and Donut enter the Second Floor prior to collapse countdown activation.
The formal 6-day Second Floor collapse countdown activates as Dungeon Crawler World: Earth episode four airs, recapping the final 30 hours of Floor 1.
Carl acquires the Goo-Inator 3000.

item.name: Goo-Inator 3000
item.description: A shaping tool that can be used at a workbench.

events.summary: Carl acquires the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph.

item.name: Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph
item.description: A limited-use kit that adds 15% bare-foot attack damage, makes Carl's feet unbreakable, and warns of foot-triggered traps five seconds before activation.

events.summary: Cascadia's introductory announcement activates ratings, follows, and favorites; establishes three-patron limits and future auction rules; and activates the human-born bathroom-violation penalty, which summons a Level 93 Rage Elemental.
The system reports 1,033,992 crawlers remaining on the Second Floor.
Dungeon Crawler World episode five airs while Carl, Donut, and the Meadow Lark party camp in a safe room with a Rage Elemental outside; Carl's Jug O' Boom is added to the Dungeon Codex.

Cascadia's follow-up patch relocates Satan's Lil' Hedgehogs to a deeper floor and establishes that safe rooms close one hour before floor collapse, teleporting remaining occupants outside; it also introduces the safe-room-only Time to Safe Room Closure countdown.
Carl kills a Level 93 Rage Elemental by luring it into a stairwell with the Mother of All Bombs, an oil slick, and Donut's Puddle Jumper; the kill awards no experience.
The surviving Meadow Lark residents descend safely to the Third Floor.
Carl acquires the Enchanted BigBoi Boxers.

item.name: Enchanted BigBoi Boxers
item.description: Enchanted boxers that add 2 Constitution and grant the Protective Shell spell.

events.summary: The Enchanted BigBoi Boxers grant Carl Protective Shell.
Donut joins the Dungeon Book of the Floor Club and receives Second Chance.

acquisitionSource.name: Dungeon Book of the Floor Club

events.summary: Carl reaches Level 11.
Carl invents Carl's Jug O' Boom.

quantity.note: The source establishes Carl's invention but not a stable carried quantity.

events.summary: Carl unlocks Dungeonpreneur.

achievement.title: Dungeonpreneur
achievement.description: Invented Carl’s Jug O’ Boom, a stackable dungeon device.

reward.description: A lifetime gold-coin royalty for kills other crawlers make with the invention.

events.summary: Dungeonpreneur grants Carl a royalty entitlement for kills made with his invention.

entitlement.name: Dungeonpreneur royalty
entitlement.description: Carl receives a gold-coin royalty for kills made with his invention by other crawlers.

events.summary: Carl acquires a Proximity Trigger for use with non-static traps.

item.name: Proximity Trigger
item.description: A Sapper's-table component that can be attached to a non-static trap.

quantity.note: The source confirms acquisition but not a stable count.

events.summary: Dungeon Crawler World episode six airs.

Cascadia's daily announcement reports 990,303 crawlers remaining; permits Game Guides to explain Third Floor race/class selection; stops non-sapient mobs from disintegrating in stairwells; halves Brindled Vespas and slightly lowers their acid-spit damage; and reduces Brindle Grub pupa advancement to 50% while retaining corpse generation.
The Royal Court reaches 212 billion views and 4.4 billion followers.
Mukta overrides Zev's scheduling and forces Carl and Donut onto Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem.
Carl goads the Maestro into rescuing Li Jun, Li Na, Zhang, and their manager.
A fabricated snick video goes viral, increasing Carl and Donut's view counts without a sourced numeric change.
Dungeon Crawler World episode seven airs.
Carl unlocks What Goes Up....

achievement.title: What Goes Up...
achievement.description: Survived the Reverse Gravity spell.

reward.description: Carl can truthfully say he is more durable than Albert II, a rhesus monkey.

events.summary: The party unlocks Like a Moth to the Flame.

achievement.title: Like a Moth to the Flame
achievement.description: Damaged a mob more than 75 levels above the crawler.

reward.description: Platinum Lucky Bastard Box containing a lottery scratch-off ticket

events.summary: Carl unlocks Grease Monkey!.

achievement.title: Grease Monkey!
achievement.description: Built and deployed a wheeled device.

events.summary: Carl unlocks You Call That a Trap?.

achievement.title: You Call That a Trap?
achievement.description: A mob was hurt by something Carl deliberately left in the dungeon.

events.summary: Mongo bonds to Donut and joins the Royal Court.
Carl reaches Level 12.
Dungeon Crawler World episode eight airs.
Agatha reappears alive at the stairwell.
Carl realizes that Agatha's absorbed shopping-cart contents include illegal Valtay Corporation technology.
The party unlocks I'll Take the Ceramic Dalmatian, Pat!.

achievement.title: I'll Take the Ceramic Dalmatian, Pat!
achievement.description: Discovered a reward room.

reward.description: No material reward; the reward room is the reward.

events.summary: Donut unlocks Menagerie!.

achievement.title: Menagerie!
achievement.description: Discovered a pet reward room.

reward.description: A key that opens one cage in the pet reward room.

events.summary: Carl unlocks PETA Enthusiast!.

achievement.title: PETA Enthusiast!
achievement.description: Removed an aggravated non-sapient enemy’s hostility and caused it to fight other enemies.

events.summary: Carl reaches Level 13 before leaving the Second Floor.
Crawlers can descend to Floor 3 without the usual six-hour loss.
Carl, Donut, and Mongo descend to the Third Floor.
The Second Floor collapses and the human-born bathroom-violation penalty is lifted.
